---
title: "Snail 92 N-of-1 Discontinuation Trial"
---

This repository contains the reproducible-research scaffold for a personal n-of-1 skincare discontinuation trial of COSRX Advanced Snail 92 All In One Cream.

The primary question is:

> Can Snail 92 be removed from the current routine without worsening skin outcomes, while keeping the rest of the routine unchanged?

The project is currently in the scaffold/preregistration stage. The revised preregistration-ready protocol is the source of truth for the trial design, outcome hierarchy, decision rule, randomization restrictions, and analysis sequence. The original draft and expert stress-test report are retained as provenance.

No trial results are reported here yet. Analysis pages are placeholders for future reproducible reports generated from collected data.

## Analysis Workflow

The analysis will follow the order below:

1. Import raw diary, weekly review, safety, deviation, and photo metadata files.
2. Validate required fields, date continuity, treatment condition values, adherence fields, and score ranges.
3. Derive preregistered scores, especially Morning Barrier Burden Score (MBBS).
4. Run the preregistered exact randomization analysis before any exploratory interpretation.
5. Run sensitivity analyses and exploratory summaries after the primary analysis is locked.

The Quarto pages under `analysis/` are structured so the project can render before trial data exist.
